name: Cornish Gems (Gwithian homes)
accommodation: Six homes in Gwithian sleeping 4 to 8 (Barefoot Beach House, Dune Hideaway, Midwinter x2, Bay Retreat, Driftwood)
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting a self-catering house near the dunes
parking: All homes in this area have private parking; number of spaces varies
dogs: Some homes are dog friendly (one to three dogs depending on property)
beachAccess: Homes are in or beside the dunes and within walking distance of the beach; Dune Hideaway is described as moments from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Private parking, dog-friendly options at selected homes
overview: Cornish Gems runs a small collection of self-catering homes at Gwithian, several set in the dunes behind the beach and one on the edge of the nature reserve. Properties sleep between four and eight, and all have private parking. Some are set further back among the dunes, but every one is within walking distance of the sand.
surfTripFit: Staying in the dunes means a short walk to check the surf at Gwithian, with space for a group and their kit.
